thread:
raja: Heads-up  i'm iterating on an "auto-fallback with staged handback" UX. main goals: clear cause, replayable audit, and safe samples. need quick engineering + ops + privacy takes.
claire: love the staged handback idea. operator inbox needs compact context: trigger short code + one-line reason + a small "why" pill (e.g., latency spike, model OOM, quota).
ben: agree. i'd add a small confidence indicator (low/med/high) representing signal strength so operators know how noisy the trigger was.
eli: telemetry requirements: every fallback event should include trigger_id, trigger_window, policy_id, and policy_snapshot_id. also emit step_index for staged handbacks.
raja: runtime behavior: when staged handback runs, we apply steps [10,50,100] by default with a configurable step_interval. UI should visualize progress and allow role-gated overrides.
ops-bot: Alert: auto-fallback applied to /chat at 2024-08-02T16:02:35Z (trigger_id=trg_5c22, policy_id=pf_live_9).
claire: samples: default capture = first_3_non_pii requests. show them inline in audit with shield icon if redacted. privacy-bot: confirm redaction requirement.
privacy-bot: samples must be redacted by default. store full snapshot only if tenant allows; otherwise store redacted blobs. log redaction=true in audit event.
ben: backend policy sketch (pseudo-json): { mode: staged, trigger: {type: error_rate, pct: 4}, hysteresis: {min_hits:3, cooldown_s:300}, steps:[10,50,100], sample_policy: first_n_non_pii:3 }
eli: also include a replay_token so the audit UI can ask the replay service to reconstruct the exact requests for the trigger window (read-only).
raja: UI actions: [Pause Auto] (suppress further auto-fallbacks for window), [Step Back] (rollback one staged step), [Escalate] (create incident). all actions must append immutable operator notes.
claire: UX: timeline with per-step status (pending, applied, failed) and hover-card showing metrics delta + link to samples. compact mode shows a small badge on the route row: "staged fallback (50%)".
ben: edge-case: flip-flop / oscillation. policy should support max_cycles_per_hour and exponential backoff on step_interval. show cycle count in UI.
eli: logging: emit single-line events for step_attempt, step_result, step_failure with keys: ts, route, policy_id, trigger_id, step_index, reason, quick_stats, blob_ptr. full snapshot to blobstore.
ops-bot: Note: quota-triggered fallbacks should include affected_commit_id for billing correlation.
privacy-bot: redaction rules draft: strip tokens, emails, and customer identifiers; mask free-text spans longer than 200 chars; flag any sample with suspected PII and do not show inline without manual unredact by authorized roles.
raja: follow-ups: 1) eli & ben finalize event schema + replay_token contract; 2) claire & ux-bot wireframe compact timeline + preview overlay; 3) privacy-bot + ops align redaction defaults. reconvene tomorrow 11:00am PT.
claire: i'll mock the route-row badge and timeline cards by EOD.
eli: will push event spec to the repo and a minimal OpenAPI endpoint for preview-simulate.
ben: will add hysteresis params to the policy schema and a max_cycles guard.
raja: thanks team 44d see you at 11:00.
